    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    up = down = 0
    for r in range(h - 1):
        for c in range(w - 2):
            if grid[r][c+1] == 2 and all(grid[r+1][c+i] == 2 for i in range(3)):

    for n, offset, color in ((up, 0, 3), (down, 3, 1)):

    return out
